motion.name: success-reveal
motion.purpose: Success messages reveal from clip-path inset(0 0 100% 0) to inset(0); disabled under prefers-reduced-motion: reduce.

components.name: Primary button
components.css: .ds-primary { font-family: 'Public Sans Variable', sans-serif; font-size: 16px; min-height: 44px; padding: 11px 20px; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 6px; background: var(--accent, #245d48); color: white; font-weight: 600; cursor: pointer; } .ds-primary:hover:not(:disabled) { background: #194734; } .ds-primary:disabled { opacity: 0.5; cursor: not-allowed; } .ds-primary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #367b64; outline-offset: 4px; }

components.name: Secondary button
components.css: .ds-secondary { font-family: 'Public Sans Variable', sans-serif; font-size: 16px; min-height: 44px; padding: 11px 20px; border: 1px solid var(--line, #d9dfd8); border-radius: 6px; background: white; color: #273e32; font-weight: 600; cursor: pointer; } .ds-secondary:hover:not(:disabled) { background: #edf2eb; } .ds-secondary:disabled { opacity: 0.5; cursor: not-allowed; } .ds-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #367b64; outline-offset: 4px; }

components.name: Labeled input
components.description: Sync form field with a visible label.
components.html: <label class="ds-label" for="ds-label-input">Gmail label</label><input class="ds-input" id="ds-label-input" placeholder="Label name">
components.css: .ds-label { display: block; font-family: 'Public Sans Variable', sans-serif; color: #202b27; font-weight: 600; font-size: 13px; margin-bottom: 9px; } .ds-input { font-family: 'Public Sans Variable', sans-serif; font-size: 16px; width: 100%; min-height: 44px; min-width: 0; border: 1px solid #a8b4aa; border-radius: 5px; padding: 10px 12px; background: #fff; color: #202b27; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: #626c65; } .ds-input:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #367b64; outline-offset: 4px; }

components.name: Navigation
components.description: Header links with an underlined active destination.
components.html: EmailsTemplates
components.css: .ds-nav { display: flex; gap: 8px; font-family: 'Public Sans Variable', sans-serif; } .ds-nav a { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; min-height: 44px; padding: 10px 14px; border-radius: 6px; text-decoration: none; text-underline-offset: 4px; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 600; color: var(--muted, #59645e); } .ds-nav a:hover, .ds-nav a[aria-current='page'] { background: #edf2eb; color: var(--accent, #245d48); } .ds-nav a[aria-current='page'] { text-decoration: underline; } .ds-nav a:hover { text-decoration-thickness: 2px; } .ds-nav a:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #367b64; outline-offset: 4px; } @media (max-width: 640px) { .ds-nav a { padding-inline: 10px; } }

components.name: Action panel
components.description: Bordered white container for sync and extraction controls.
components.html:
Extract templates

Process all stored emails without a template.
components.css: .ds-panel { font-family: 'Public Sans Variable', sans-serif; color: #202b27; padding: 26px 28px; border: 1px solid var(--line, #d9dfd8); border-radius: 12px; background: #fff; } .ds-panel h2 { margin: 0; font-size: 19px; letter-spacing: -0.02em; font-weight: 650; } .ds-panel p { margin: 7px 0 0; font-size: 14px; line-height: 1.6; color: var(--muted, #59645e); } @media (max-width: 640px) { .ds-panel { padding: 22px 20px; } }

components.name: Template row
components.description: Whole-row link with a two-line pattern preview, count, and chevron.
components.html: Template 1Your transaction details3 emails
components.css: .ds-row { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 24px; padding: 22px 8px; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line, #d9dfd8); text-decoration: none; color: #202b27; font-family: 'Public Sans Variable', sans-serif; font-size: 16px; } .ds-row:hover { background: #edf1e9; } .ds-row:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #367b64; outline-offset: 4px; } .ds-copy { flex: 1; min-width: 0; } .ds-name { display: block; font-weight: 600; margin-bottom: 8px; } .ds-preview { display: -webkit-box; -webkit-line-clamp: 2; -webkit-box-orient: vertical; overflow: hidden; overflow-wrap: anywhere; color: var(--muted, #59645e); font-size: 14px; line-height: 1.6; } .ds-total { color: var(--muted, #59645e); font-size: 14px; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; white-space: nowrap; } .ds-chevron { width: 16px; height: 16px; fill: none; stroke: var(--muted, #59645e); stroke-width: 1.5; flex-shrink: 0; } @media (max-width: 640px) { .ds-row { flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 10px; padding: 20px 0; } .ds-copy { flex-basis: 100%; } .ds-total { flex: 1; } }

components.name: Review status badge
components.description: Compact template and parser state label using success, review, or neutral colors.
components.css: .ds-parser-status { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; min-height: 24px; padding: 2px 8px; border: 1px solid #dfc26b; border-radius: 5px; background: #fff1c2; color: #634600; font-family: 'Public Sans Variable', sans-serif; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 650; line-height: 1.4; white-space: nowrap; }
